artifact_observations.reasoning: The surfaces of the tomatoes and garlic bulbs appear overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the natural micro-texture and imperfections expected in real produce. This suggests a slight 'waxy' AI generation artifact.

The pile of green beans lacks distinct individual separation in the center; some stems appear to fuse together or terminate abruptly without clear endpoints, a common generative issue with tangled linear objects.
The inner walls of the box show slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines, particularly on the right side, though this could also be attributed to camera lens distortion or box deformation.
